name.en: Chinese Government Scholarship — High-Level Postgraduate Program at CUMTB 2026
name.zh: 中国政府奖学金—中国矿业大学（北京）高水平研究生项目（2026）
name.ru: Стипендия правительства Китая — программа подготовки магистрантов и докторантов высокого уровня CUMTB 2026

scholarshipCandidates.scope: International applicants to eligible CUMTB master's and doctoral degree programs under the 2026 Chinese Government Scholarship High-Level Postgraduate route.

tiers: Coverage components are governed by the current CSC rules cited by CUMTB

evidence.sourceTitle: CUMTB 2026 Chinese Government Scholarship High-Level Postgraduate Program Guide

summary.en: CUMTB's official guide describes a full Chinese Government Scholarship route for international master's and doctoral applicants entering in September 2026. CUMTB recommends candidates and CSC makes the final selection; the 28 February 2026 deadline is closed, and benefit details remain subject to CSC rules.
summary.zh: 中国矿业大学（北京）官方指南说明该项目为面向2026年9月入学国际硕博申请人的中国政府全额奖学金路线，由学校推荐、国家留学基金委最终评审；2026年2月28日截止，当前已关闭，具体资助内容以国家留学基金委规定为准。
summary.ru: Официальное руководство CUMTB описывает полную государственную стипендию Китая для иностранных магистрантов и докторантов с началом в сентябре 2026 года. Университет рекомендует кандидатов, окончательный отбор проводит CSC; срок 28 февраля 2026 года закрыт, состав покрытия определяется правилами CSC.

name.zh: 中国科学院大学国际学生奖学金（2026）

scholarshipCandidates.scope: Institution-wide scholarship route for eligible international applicants to UCAS master's and doctoral degree programs.

tiers: Full scholarship: tuition and application fee waiver
Full scholarship: total monthly stipend of at least RMB 3,000 for master's students and RMB 3,500 for doctoral students

evidence.sourceTitle: UCAS Scholarship for International Students 2026 Call for Applications

summary.en: UCAS's official 2026 call offers full and partial scholarships at university scope to eligible international applicants in master's and doctoral degree programs. The full award waives tuition and the application fee and provides a stipend, basic accommodation and insurance; published minimum total stipends are RMB 3,000 per month for master's students and RMB 3,500 for doctoral students. The degree-program deadline of 31 January 2026 is closed.
summary.zh: 中国科学院大学2026官方通知以学校层面面向符合条件的国际硕士和博士学位项目申请人提供全额和部分奖学金。全额奖学金免学费和申请费，并提供生活费、基本住宿和保险；公布的总生活费最低标准为硕士每月3000元、博士每月3500元。学位项目2026年1月31日截止，当前已关闭。
summary.ru: Официальный набор UCAS 2026 предлагает на уровне университета полные и частичные стипендии подходящим иностранным кандидатам на программы магистратуры и докторантуры. Полная стипендия освобождает от платы за обучение и подачу, предоставляет выплату, базовое жильё и страховку; минимум составляет 3 000 юаней в месяц для магистрантов и 3 500 для докторантов. Срок для программ степени 31 января 2026 года закрыт.

mergeAudit.officialDomainPolicy: Program and scholarship evidence is restricted to official university HTTPS domains: studyinbeijing.cnu.edu.cn, www.cup.edu.cn, international.cumtb.edu.cn and english.ucas.ac.cn. Official university application portals are used only as applicationUrl.
mergeAudit.dynamicFactPolicy: Dated 2026 cycles whose deadlines precede the 2026-07-31 check date are explicitly closed and never displayed as open. CNU's reachable 2025 prospectus is used only to establish stable program identity; its fees, durations and dates are not carried forward.

excludedCandidates.reason: All 2025-only fees, durations and application dates were excluded from current facts because no reachable current official cycle corroborated them.

The master's-level and doctoral-level UCAS admission entry points were excluded because they are degree-level umbrellas rather than concrete programs. The UCAS scholarship remains at institution scope for master's and doctoral applicants and is not bound to a program candidate until a specific official program can be verified.
